blindPixelObservations: Portrait-format illustrated card with a dark blue-violet science-fiction room occupying the upper two-thirds and magenta interface borders around the lower text area.

At left-center, a bulky suited figure is shown mostly from behind facing a dark equipment box or console at right; the figure carries several red circular packs on the upper back, and red indicator lights glow on the equipment.
Black cables arc across the ceiling and run around the equipment; bright cream light spills from a doorway or opening in the center-right background.
A small white horizontally elongated emblem in the upper-right is covered by a large red diagonal X.
The title is large bold uppercase white text in a black beveled plaque with magenta edging.
The rules block is centered white mixed-case text on a dark maroon-to-black panel; one solid white polygonal icon interrupts the third rules line.
A spaced magenta uppercase category word is centered at the bottom.
